wayback._note: Two domains: kpcb.com (the firm's site from the 1990s until the 2019 rebrand to Kleiner Perkins) and kleinerperkins.com (2019 on, WordPress, read live through its REST API). The Internet Archive stood in a machine-wide firewall cooldown when this run started (2026-09-30, ~314 min left), so the archive layer runs on Common Crawl first (scratch/cc-cluster.py, cc-fetch.py, both keys com,kpcb) and com,kleinerperkins)), with every parsed row carrying its own capture URL; the Internet Archive fills the pre-2008 years once the cooldown clears. site_url_base is the live site (kleinerperkins.com) so the base build recognises the firm's own per-company pages as stage citations; cdx_domain stays kpcb.com for the archive.

roster._note: The roster is built by scratch/build-roster.py from first-party people pages (the archived kpcb.com team pages via Common Crawl and the live WordPress person collection) with investing titles only; see that script's docstring.

sources._note: The live portfolio: every published WordPress `company` entry (416), read through the site's public REST API by scratch/pull-wp.py and flattened by scratch/shape-site.py. Per company the firm states its first-investment stage (Early or Growth), the since-year, whether the company is Current or Prior, its current stage (Early, Growth, IPO, Acquired) and, for exits, the acquirer.

site_api._note: kleinerperkins.com is WordPress with ACF; /wp-json/wp/v2/ serves company, person, deck and posts with their taxonomies (stage, sector, person_role) without a token.
site_api._entry_stage_note: stage_site is the CMS first_investment_stage, the firm's own label for the round it entered (a separate current_stage field carries the company's stage now), so it is eligible (decisions.md D7). Values: Early or Growth. Early straddles Seed, Series A and Series B and is an anchor only (scored 2026-09-30 against cited entry rounds: 63 Series A, 27 Seed, 38 Growth); Growth labels at HIGH confidence: 42 of 43 cited rows are Series B or later (scratch/stage-score.json; the one miss is Collective Medical, a Series A). A documented round overrides with stage_disputes_band.

edgar.fts_own_pattern: ^(kleiner perkins caufield (&|and) byers|kleiner perkins (caufield & byers )?(\d+|[ivx]+)\b|kleiner perkins (select|flex|xx|xxi|xxii|xix)|kpcb (holdings|digital growth|green growth|pandemic|ifund|sfund|edge|xii|xiii|xiv|xv|xvi|xvii|xviii|xix)|kp (select|sightglass|flex|xx|xxi|xxii|growth))
edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases. 'KPCB' is distinctive on EDGAR; 'Kleiner Perkins' also hits law-firm and namesake noise, read once. S-1 holder tables name the firm as 'entities affiliated with Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers' and its vehicles by their LLC names.

desks._note: Provisional until entities.json is read: one exempt reporting adviser, Kleiner Perkins (Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers, LLC), CRD 161035, SEC 802-75571, whose Schedule D 7.B.(1) (ADV signed 2026-03-31, data/filings/adv/161035.pdf) reports the numbered KPCB funds XII-XIX and Kleiner Perkins XX-XXII with their founders and friends funds, Kleiner Perkins Select Fund I-IV, Flex I, KP Sightglass I-II, KPCB Digital Growth Fund I-III, KPCB Green Growth Fund and KPCB China Fund II. External: Bond (Bond Capital Management, LP, CRD 304391), the growth team that left in 2018 with its own adviser and funds (Bond Capital Fund, Bond II, Bond III); KPCB China Management, Ltd. (CRD 161470, SEC 802-75570), its own exempt reporting adviser for KPCB China Fund, L.P. and KPCB China Founders Fund, with KP a minority shareholder (decisions.md D1, D2). The KPCB China vehicles (Fund, Founders Fund, Fund II, their associates and holdings entities) are home desk under the provisional X1 reading (IN, re-derived 2026-09-30). The iFund-named filers on EDGAR (iFund I, iFund Investment Group, iFund Diversified / Key Income / Strategic Income / Tactical Growth, iFunds Cash Solutions, iFundWomen) are namesakes of KPCB's 2008 iFund programme, which invested through the numbered KPCB funds.
